scope: Existing result artifacts only; no new source OHLC, pickle or holdout reads
verdict: No material arithmetic, denominator or pairing errors found
cash_identity: final_balance = 1000 + sum(accepted ledger pnl), including boundary marks
controls: Every trade has five serialized matched draws; extra attempts represent rejected boundary draws

checks: Strict K/D 20 or 80 crossover against previous closed bar
exit open equals signal bar open plus four hours
parent_4h_signal_checks.limitation: One trade contributes about 73.5 percent of total net profit; signal arithmetic is not independent strategy validation

limitations: Capacity rejection changes later serial admission; cash and unconstrained trade counts are different denominators
Profitability gate uses signal close; next-open fill is not guaranteed profitable
